SourceConsumeState.source_cost_multiplie.rule: Source-backed per-block cost multiplier; unit factories pay Rules.unitCost, other blocks pay the 1.0 default; a ContinuousLiquidTurret pays 1 / ammoMultiplier for its current liquid, 1.0 when the liquid has no ammo type.

SourceContinuousLiquidTurretBuildState.s.rule: Source-backed ContinuousLiquidTurret live-loop tick and placement frame binding; the frame is bound when the block is placed (Block.newBuilding) and its keys are refreshed from the live liquid module every simulate_factory tick, so the N2101 cost multiplier is paid live, and the tick runs the bound RuntimeConsumer actors through updateConsumption so the placed turret consumes its ammo liquid each tick.
